title: Fix Puzzle 2d Duplicate Import
description: Fix duplicate import of puzzle2dFixtureMergedKindCatalogs in playground renderer react index.tsx causing vite/babel build error for puzzle-2d entry.
summary: Duplicate `puzzle2dFixtureMergedKindCatalogs` in the Puzzle2dPlayHost `@semio-tech/puzzle-2d-react` import block was already removed (second copy after `applyBrushPlacementToFixture`). Added `duplicateNamedImportsForModule` plus a vitest guard on the real stripped puzzle-2d virtual entry so Babel cannot regress with duplicate named imports. If the overlay persists, restart the puzzle-2d Vite dev server (stale transform cache).
